title: Native ingress principal-v3 session evidence
description: Explicit principal-v3 only. Exact seven-field response, compact JSON plus one LF, at most 98304 bytes including LF. Existing v1/v2 profiles do not accept this evidence. Shape neither authenticates the quoted principal nor permits CONNECT or another operation. The separate request-exporter secret and original authentication headers are never included.

tlsExporterBase64url.description: Normal public session exporter echo. The receiver derives its own actual value; this is NOT the secret request-binding exporter.

publicIdentityBase64url.description: Exact nested nativeIngressPublicEvidence/v2 original with LF, at most 65536 decoded bytes. Its genuine role-3 quote nonce uses the new principal-session domain, actual challenge/exporter and SHA256 of the exact principal preflight original. Existing client-root inventory commitment and actual peer verification remain required.

principalPreflightBase64url.description: Exact nativePrincipalPreflight/v1 compact canonical UTF-8 original without LF, at most 4096 decoded bytes. The paired receiver verifies independent expected principal/identity policy, actual quoted policy, actual selected leaf/SPKI, exact sent request HMAC and the genuine quote's statement-bound nonce.
